Enablement Plan Powered by Tigerhall
Change Management & Agency Enablement

Confidence and consistency, at every step.

Adoption doesn't happen because a playbook exists. It happens because every person who touches the taxonomy workflow — brand, ops, analytics, or agency — knows exactly what changed, why it matters to them, and what they need to do differently. Merkle's approach runs on three pillars.

01

Team-based training & communications

Role-specific playbooks built around real Amgen campaign scenarios. A communications plan that drives awareness before go-live and sustains it after.

02

Center of Excellence

A governance body that fields change requests, resolves exceptions, and owns adoption metrics — with Merkle providing oversight and rapid response capacity throughout.

03

Feedback loops & product iterations

Phased rollout with pilot teams validating before broader deployment. Response cycles that fix what isn't working before it compounds.

Each pillar is only as strong as the people behind it. That's why agency partners and internal Amgen staff each follow purpose-built learning trails inside TigerHall, Amgen's learning and enablement platform — certifiable, trackable, and scoped to what each audience actually controls.
